description: Opal Trips - Ferry is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset contains Official Ferry Utilisation figures. Opal tap-on/tap-off data (representing an individual entering & exiting a wharf), is allocated to a route and aggregated to a monthly figure for the estimated number of trips. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Opal, Opal trips, Tap Off, Tap On, entering. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
